correctness.rationale: The source formula sends the zero representative \([p]^e\) to \([q]^{ev}\) times a unit, so vanishing modulo \(q^f\) is equivalent to \(ev\ge f\) and hence to the ceiling lower bound. The witness \(p=q=3\), \(e=2\), \(f=3\) makes the printed \(v=1\) stratum fail directly because zero maps to \(9\) modulo \(27\). An exhaustive multiplication-table enumeration independently finds exactly \(19\) unital multiplicative maps, matching the corrected parameter count.

The supplied exact enumeration checks all \(81\) ordered products for every candidate determined by the images of \(2\) and \(3\) and yields \(19\) maps.

searches: finite multiplication table for the multiplicative monoids modulo 9 and 27

value.rationale: The correction removes an entire parameter stratum whenever \(f>e\) and \(e\nmid f\), so it changes the paper’s complete hom-set classification rather than a cosmetic inequality. The smallest odd-prime instance changes the predicted cardinality from \(55\) to \(19\), giving a concrete and reproducible boundary failure and a corrected exact count.
